jobs.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem-solvers working together to make high-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

Your north star: To serve as a trusted strategic partner that enables sustainable growth and high-quality patient care through rigorous financial stewardship, data-driven insights, and operational excellence.

As the Senior Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations Manager, you will sit at the intersection of strategic RCM, financial collaboration, data analytics, and operational project management. In our fast-growing startup environment, we operate across multiple complex lines of business, ranging from a per engaged member per month (PEMPM) capitation model to highly specialized Fee-For-Service (FFS) lines with new novel models being piloted. In this role, you will step up to navigate complex commercial agreements to secure high-value partnerships and improve deal velocity, design novel FFS/PEMPM hybrid billing structures to unlock additional revenue opportunities, and serve as the dedicated resource for high-level RCM escalations that currently flow directly to leadership.

This role reports to the Head of RCM and is open to any candidates located in the continental US.

What you’ll do: 

 - Partner with Finance and Sales to design competitive pricing strategies, build hybrid FFS/PEMPM billing models, and lead RCM onboarding for new B2B clients.

 - Serve as the dedicated resolution point for high-level RCM escalations to streamline operations and protect leadership bandwidth.

 - Collaborate with internal tech teams to build, optimize, and scale proprietary RCM software, maintaining data integrity across EHRs, clearinghouses, and BI platforms.

 - Monitor regulatory updates, healthcare policy shifts, and payer rule changes to evaluate their financial impact and adapt systems preemptively.

 - Use BI tools and advanced financial modeling to analyze key performance metrics, audit billing workflows, reconcile payments, and surface denial patterns.

 - Develop quality assurance frameworks, standard operating procedures, and audit guidelines to elevate operational rigor.

 - Oversee day-to-day revenue cycle execution—including claims submission, clearinghouse error resolution, payment posting, and root-cause denial prevention.

Who You Are:

 - 5–7 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience, ideally within a healthcare startup, digital health company, or a multi-specialty group.

 - Proven ability to partner with Finance to design pricing structures and collaborate with Product/Tech to build scalable operational tools.

 - Deep understanding of commercial and Medicaid insurance billing, claim formats, and denial resolution.

 - Experience leading coding discussions and navigating non-traditional or emerging healthcare benefits (like doula care or value-based capitation models) is highly preferred.

 - Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel. Experience writing basic SQL or using BI tools like Metabase, Tableau, or Looker to pull data is highly preferred, alongside leveraging AI to improve efficiency and effectiveness of work products.

 - Proven track record of managing high-impact projects, implementing new software configurations, and building cross-departmental consensus as a senior individual contributor.

 - A builder and a strategist. You thrive in ambiguity, take pride in resolving complex organizational headwinds, and enjoy designing "how things should work" rather than just following an old playbook.


WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.

Benefits and Perks:

 - Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their families

 - High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options

 - Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

 - Equity grant participation

 - 401(k) program 

 - Competitive vacation policy 

 - 16 weeks paid parental leave 

 - Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)

Compensation:

The expected base salary range offered for this role is $135,000-$150,000. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo’s mission. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

We are committed to hiring the best team to improve outcomes for all mothers and babies. To solve the complex challenges facing the diverse population we serve, we need diverse perspectives, actively welcoming people of all races, ages, sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions, national origins, religions, disabilities, and veteran statuses. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and respectful environment where team members thrive by working across disciplines, moving fast, making data driven decisions, learning continuously, and always putting the patient first.

Your North Star: Support the training, quality, and operations of our outreach team.

As an Outreach Training and Program Manager, you will partner closely with our existing Training and Program Manager to co-lead the onboarding, ongoing development, and operational infrastructure of our outreach specialists. You will be responsible for supporting team operations by training new and current hires, performance managing new hires during their onboarding period, overseeing quality assurance, creating knowledge bases within our software systems, and supporting administrative functions across the team such as verifying eligibility and responding to new patient inquiries. Additionally, you will flex into the role of inbound/outbound calling as needed.

The ideal candidate will possess excellent organizational skills, deep experience leading training and shadowing sessions, and a collaborative mindset to share leadership responsibilities effectively.

 - Co-Leadership & Training: Work in lockstep with our current Training and Program Manager to train all new hires on the outreach team, which includes hosting training sessions on outreach processes and best practices, shadowing sessions, and creating training materials.

 - Performance Management: Manage performance for all new hires on the outreach team, including achieving 100% of all milestones during the onboarding period.

 - Training Operations: Project manage and execute all training operations including, but not limited to: ensuring timely equipment receipt, on-time completion of training cycles, and management of training/onboarding schedules.

 - Quality Assurance: Own quality assurance during the onboarding period by listening to new hire calls, scoring the calls, and providing synthesized, actionable feedback.

 - Administrative Support: Manage administrative functions of the role, which include completing eligibility checks through internal tools, building/maintaining operational process documents related to enrollment, updating call documentation errors, managing support tickets with our telephony vendor, and managing time cards.

 - Patient Outreach and Engagement: Manage inbound calls from potential patients, and as needed conduct outbound calls and digital outreach (SMS, email) to patients to provide information and education about Pomelo Care services and resources.

Who you are:

 - Experience in training, quality assurance, and performance management, preferably within healthcare or in a call center environment.

 - Proven track record of leading engaging training sessions, conducting shadowing and coaching sessions.

 - Strong background in QA call scoring, tracking performance metrics, and managing administrative logistics (eligibility tools, timecards).

 - A team-first mentality with the proven ability to partner effectively with a co-manager. Willingness to “roll up your sleeves” and directly engage with patients.

 - Earned your Bachelor's degree in education, healthcare, or a related field.

 - Consistently demonstrate high-quality execution and reliability.

 - Able to work some evenings and weekends, with a standard schedule of Monday-Friday 8:30am-5pm CT.

Bonus points if you have any of the following:

 - Experience working in a fast-paced and dynamic startup environment.

 - Are a NBC-HWC certified Health Coach.

 - Are fluent in speaking and writing in Spanish.

 - Ability to scope and tackle ambiguous problems.

The expected salary for this role is $90,000-$115,000. This role is also eligible for a monthly bonus, and equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo’s mission.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Pomelo Care is the leading virtual medical practice for women and children, providing care across pregnancy, postpartum, pediatrics, menopause, and perimenopause. We combine proactive, 24/7 clinical care with technology that helps us reach patients earlier, identify risks sooner, and deliver personalized care throughout their journey. Our team includes clinicians, technologists, operators, and problem-solvers working together to make high-quality care more accessible for families nationwide.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring for a Revenue Operations Manager to own the data, systems, and analysis behind how we plan and grow revenue. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance leaders, and you will be trusted to find the important questions yourself, not only answer the ones you are handed.



AI is changing how operations work gets done. We want someone who is already building with it and is eager to bring that into how our revenue team runs.



This role reports to the Head of Strategic Finance and can be based anywhere in the continental U.S. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own revenue reporting and dashboards. Build and maintain the dashboards leaders use to run the business: pipeline, forecast, conversion, retention, and rep performance.

 - Run analysis end to end. Scope the question, pull the data via SFDC or SQL, do the analysis, and present a clear conclusion and recommendation.

 - Manage our tech stack. Maintain and improve how our teams use tools (Outreach, Clay, Gong, etc.), driving adoption, efficiency, and insight gathering.

 - Build with AI. Find manual, repetitive, or slow parts of the revenue process and build AI-powered workflows, agents, or tools that fix them. Help the wider go-to-market team adopt what works.

 - Improve the funnel. Spot where deals stall or leak between stages and teams, and work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to fix it.

 - Keep the data trustworthy. Own CRM data quality, metric definitions, and the processes that keep our numbers consistent across teams.

 - Be a partner to leadership. Bring insights to revenue leaders before they ask, and tell them plainly what the data does and does not support.

 - Ad hoc analyses and projects as needed




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 4+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or a similar analytical role, and you understand how a B2B funnel works ideally in telehealth

 - Excited about AI and eager to build. You have built with AI in a professional or personal setting, such as an automation, an agent, an internal tool, or a side project, and you can walk us through what you made and what you learned.

 - Fluent in CRM data. You have worked hands-on with Salesforce, HubSpot, or a similar CRM and know where its data goes wrong.

 - A strong analyst. You can run an analysis on your own from raw data to recommendation, and you are careful about whether the numbers are right.

 - Comfortable in SQL and  familiar with BI tools (Metabase, Hex, SFDC).

 - A clear communicator. You explain findings simply to non-technical stakeholders and are willing to push back when the data disagrees with the room.




WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

By joining Pomelo, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast-moving, well-funded, and mission-driven startup that always puts the patient first. You will learn, grow and be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it.

We strive to create an environment where employees from all backgrounds are respected. We value working across disciplines, moving fast, data-driven decision making, learning, and always putting the patient first.




BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees and their families

 - High deductible Health Plans with Health Savings Account (HSA) options

 - Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

 - Equity grant participation

 - 401(k) program

 - Competitive vacation policy

 - 16 weeks paid parental leave

 - Fully remote work flexibility (within the US)




COMPENSATION

The expected base salary range offered for this role is $145,000 - $165,000. This role is also eligible for equity, giving you an ownership stake in Pomelo’s mission. Actual compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.
